collections.name: GTI Max Cleantech
collections.description:
Opis:
GTI Max Cleantech su modularne industrijske ploce za ciste tehnicke prostore i brzu renovaciju bez dugog prekida rada.

Ugradnja:
Loose lay / Connect sistem sa vodonepropusnim resenjem za zahtevne objekte.

Primena:
Clean room, farmacija, laboratorije, proizvodnja i logistika sa visokim saobracajem.

Kljucne prednosti:
Pogodno za clean room.
Vodonepropusan sistem.
Otpornost na visok saobracaj.

collections.name: GTI Max Connect
collections.description:
Opis:
GTI Max Connect su industrijske ploce za fast-track renovacije, logistiku i zone sa velikim opterecenjem gde je vazno brzo pustanje prostora u rad.

Ugradnja:
Loose lay / Connect sistem bez komplikovane pripreme podloge.

Primena:
Industrija, logistika, radionice, skladista i prostori visokog saobracaja.

Kljucne prednosti:
Loose lay ugradnja.
Visok saobracaj.
Laka renovacija.

GTI Pure Connect su modularne ploce za komercijalne i tehnicke prostore gde je vazna brza renovacija, dobar habajuci sloj i cisto, uredno zoniranje.

Ugradnja:
Loose lay / Connect sistem za brzo pustanje prostora u rad.

Komercijalni i tehnicki prostori, radionice, showroom i zone visokog saobracaja.

collections.name: Attraction Connect
collections.description:
Opis:
Attraction Connect su dekorativne tehnicke ploce za prostore gde je potrebno brzo obnoviti pod i dobiti jaku vizuelnu signalizaciju kroz boju i dezen.

Ugradnja:
Loose lay / Connect sistem za brzu ugradnju i jednostavnu parcijalnu zamenu ploca.

Primena:
Komercijalni i industrijski prostori, fast-track renovacije, zone signalizacije i intenzivnog prolaza.

Kljucne prednosti:
Loose lay ugradnja.
Trend boje.
Laka renovacija.

collections.name: R Tile 5mm
collections.description:
Explore our interlocking dove tails tiles crafted for enduring robustness and adaptable for various industrial uses

Product - Slip Resistance: R10 rating ensures a safe walking surface. - Access & Corners: For safe foot and wheel traffic navigation (available in all colors) - Interlocking Design: Superior dove-tail join for a robust and seamless flooring solution. - Durability: Injection-molded tiles designed for high impact resistance and longevity. Application - Rolling Traffic: Fully compatible with pallet jacks. - Quick Installation: Hassle-free installation with minimal subfloor preparation required. - Versatile Applications: Suitable for various settings from low traffic areas to heavy industrial use. Installation - Loose Lay System: Easily removable and reusable, no adhesive needed. - Dovetail Interlocking System: Quick and simple installation. Environment - Sustainability: Made in Ireland. - Recycling: 100% recyclable with up to 80% recycled content - Compliance: Fully REACH compliant and free from phthalates (except for recycled content), heavy metals, and solvents. - Indoor Air Quality: Low TVOC emissions (< 100 micrograms/m3) and no formaldehyde.

collections.name: R Tile Excel 5mm
collections.description:
A stylish, durable, and eco-friendly interlocking flooring solution that installs quickly without adhesives—ideal for high-traffic, budget-conscious spaces.

Product - Interlocking Design: Hidden interlock system with a concrete finish, offering a seamless and aesthetic appearance. - Durability: Cost-effective and robust solution, ideal for areas requiring both style and resilience. Application - Rolling Traffic: Supports light wheeled traffic, making it suitable for trolleys and carts. - Quick Installation: Easy to install with minimal subfloor preparation, thanks to the interlocking system. - Versatile Applications: Perfect for residential and commercial spaces such as office buildings, museums, reception areas, childcare facilities, and retail environments—especially where budget-conscious design is a priority. Installation - Loose Lay System: Easily removable and reusable, no adhesive needed. - Dovetail Interlocking System: Quick and simple installation. Environment - Sustainability: Made in Ireland. - Recycling: 100% recyclable - Compliance: Fully REACH compliant and free from phthalates (except for recycled content), heavy metals, and solvents. - Indoor Air Quality: Low TVOC emissions (< 100 micrograms/m3) and no formaldehyde.

collections.name: R Tile Slate
collections.description:
Elegant, sustainable flooring with a hidden interlock system for quick, adhesive-free installation in light-use commercial and residential spaces.

Product - Interlocking Design: Hidden interlock system with a refined slate texture, allowing elegant color combinations for a seamless and stylish finish. - Durability: Designed for foot traffic only, offering a visually appealing and practical solution for light-use environments. Application - Rolling Traffic: Not intended for wheeled traffic; optimized for pedestrian use. - Quick Installation: Simple and efficient installation with minimal subfloor preparation. - Versatile Applications: Ideal for residential and commercial spaces such as reception and waiting areas, childcare facilities, healthcare venues, and hospitality settings including coffee shops, restaurants, and hotel lobbies. Installation - Loose Lay System: Easily removable and reusable, no adhesive needed. - Dovetail Interlocking System: Quick and simple installation.
